input.args: {"task":{"medium":"drive","prompt":"Through the MCP harness, spawn a headless (or desktop) substrate, load a font via `aether.text.load_font`, then render a multi-row text panel by sending a single `aether.text.draw_batch` to the `aether.text` mailbox carrying ~6 items — distinct short strings at distinct screen origins down a column, some sharing a clip. Capture a frame and confirm every row rendered. Do it without ever sending a per-string `aether.text.draw`.","surfaceUnderTest":"the `aether.text.draw_batch` mail kind (`DrawTextBatch`, whose items are `DrawText` values) on the `aether.text` mailbox — its item vector, per-item `origin` / `size_pixels` / `color` / `clip`, and the cap's coalesced `draw_textured_quads` emission.","expectedArtifact":"a captured frame showing ~6 legible, distinct text strings stacked down a column at their specified origins — all rows present (none dropped), correct left-to-right order within each string, no overlap between rows."}}
